9.text: Broadcom forecasts $21.7B in quarterly AI chip sales, up 236% year over year, and signed a 10-year VMware Cloud Foundation deal with NTT DOCOMO. CEO Hock Tan warned AI financing, not chips or power, is the coming bottleneck, while Tigress issued a $600 price target.

7.text: Marvell reported Q2 fiscal 2027 revenue of $2.74 billion, up 36.5% year-over-year, and raised fiscal 2028 guidance to $20 billion. Its stock fell 17.2% over five trading days, while record AI design wins face margin pressure from Taiwanese custom-silicon rivals.

8.text: Broadcom’s AI revenue reportedly grew 117% last quarter, and several articles compare it with Nvidia, AMD, Dell, Apple, Micron, Marvell, and Arm as an AI-chip investment. Most pieces frame Broadcom as a custom-chip and high-margin semiconductor play, with mixed views on whether it will outperform Nvidia.

6.text: Broadcom shares fell about 35% from June highs, closing near $323, as chip stocks slid; analysts nonetheless see large upside, with targets from $405 to $600. The company projected $21.7B in quarterly AI chip sales and cited VMware deals with NTT DOCOMO and FedEx.
